metadata.name: commish
metadata.description: Escrow for NFL Survivor pools and league dues

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed key takes over. Signed by that key and nobody else, which
is what proves the key exists and is held before Config is rewritten.
The proposal account closes on the way out.

instructions.name: advance_week
docs: Close the week: either the pool is decided, or it moves on.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
docs: Withdraw a proposal. Admin only.

instructions.name: claim_pot
docs: A winner takes their share.

instructions.name: claim_prize
docs: The assignee of a finalized slot takes it.

instructions.name: close_member
docs: Rent hygiene. Only once this pool can never owe this member anything.

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: Create a pool and its vault.
The commissioner does NOT get a Member here. If they are playing, the
app calls `join_pool` in the same transaction — one join path, atomic,
and no optional account to reason about.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault IS the pool's associated token account. Deriving it rather
than accepting one closes the "pass in an account you control" hole.

instructions.name: finalize_sheet
docs: The sheet survived its dispute window.

instructions.name: finalize_week
docs: The dispute window closed without a majority. Commit the week.
Permissionless on purpose: if this needed the commissioner, a
commissioner who lost interest could freeze the pot.

instructions.name: join_pool
docs: Join a pool, paying your own buy-in.

instructions.name: lock_dues
docs: Close joining and fix the prize base.
Prizes are a share of `total_dues` fixed here, NOT of the live vault
balance. An interim payout would otherwise shrink the base and quietly
change every later slot's value.

instructions.name: oracle_post_results
docs: The same proposal, signed by the results oracle instead of the
commissioner. Everything after this point is identical: the window,
the veto, the finalize. The commissioner's own door still opens.

instructions.name: post_payout_sheet
docs: The commissioner declares who gets paid what.
Assignees are passed as `remaining_accounts` — one Member PDA each — and
every one is checked to be a real, paid member of THIS pool. That is what
makes a typo'd address impossible rather than merely unlikely.

instructions.name: post_results
docs: The commissioner proposes a week's results. Nothing settles yet.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Name the key that may take over as admin. Admin only; nothing changes
until that key calls `accept_admin`. Calling this again replaces the
proposal.

instructions.name: reclaim_dues
docs: The deadman switch.
If a pool is never settled — the commissioner vanished, the season fell
apart, anything — every paid member can take their pro-rata share back
after the refund deadline. The first caller fixes the per-member number
so the last one out is not shortchanged by the ones before.

instructions.name: set_oracle
docs: Name, or replace, the key the automated poster signs with. Admin only.
One instruction for both jobs, through `init_if_needed`: the first call
creates the account and every later one rotates the key. The usual
warning about init_if_needed is re-initialisation by a stranger, and it
does not apply here because the admin gate is on Config, not on the
account being initialised.

instructions.name: settle_member
docs: Apply the finalized week to one member. Anyone may crank it, and running
it twice for the same member and week is refused rather than repeated.

instructions.name: sponsor_join
docs: The commissioner covers somebody's seat.
This is the answer to "my brother-in-law does not have a wallet with
money in it yet". The seat is real, the Member is theirs, and the record
says who paid for it.

instructions.name: submit_pick
docs: One team, to win, this week.

instructions.name: veto_results
docs: A member disputes the pending posting — results or payout sheet.
One vote per member per posting, and a STRICT majority clears it. The
commissioner then posts again. This is the check on the one piece of
trust the design keeps.

types.name: AdminAccepted
docs: The successor accepted. `previous` administers nothing from here on.

types.name: AdminProposed
docs: The admin named a successor. Nothing changes until that key accepts.

fields.name: pending
docs: The key that may call `accept_admin`.

types.name: AdminTransferCancelled
docs: The admin withdrew a proposal before it was accepted.

fields.name: used_mask
docs: Bit N set == team N already spent this season.

fields.name: current_pick
docs: 255 == no pick. Otherwise 0..=31.

fields.name: eliminated_week
docs: 0 == still alive. Otherwise the week they went out.

fields.name: vetoed_epoch
docs: The `Pool::veto_epoch` this member last voted on. 0 == never voted.

fields.name: poster
docs: The key that may call `oracle_post_results`. Rotated by the admin.

types.name: OracleSet
docs: The admin named, or replaced, the automated poster.

fields.name: winners
docs: Committed results, one bitmask per week. Bit N == team N.

types.name: PrizeSlot
docs: One payout slot in a league's prize sheet.

fields.name: state
docs: 0 unassigned · 1 pending (in dispute window) · 2 finalized · 3 claimed

types.name: ResultsPostedByOracle
docs: Emitted alongside ResultsPosted when the oracle, not the commissioner, made
the proposal. A separate event rather than a field on ResultsPosted, so the
shape an indexer already reads does not change under it.
